scope: All 13 eligible additions and one existing change; excluded Hex addition separately recorded. Includes canonical primary advisory review for one withdrawn duplicate.
methodology: Compared exact pinned database records to fetched public maintainer advisory prose and structured fields, or primary PR/release sources where no repository advisory was linked. No code or proof of concept executed.

Publication retains only allowlisted structured fields, public HTTP headers, narrative digests and independently written comparison observations. Original response and Git-blob hashes are separate from retained artifact hashes. No author, credits, private-report references, full narratives or code examples are published.
Raw version strings and source dates remain separately attributed. No CVSS score computed and no version equivalence inferred.
limitations: Primary API description review covers the delta only, not the entire Reviewed corpus.
lopdf release endpoint v0.42.0 returned 404; its fix version remains database-attributed. Primary PR supports the remediation mechanism only.
No independent KEV or exploitation verification; unknown does not mean absent.
Maintainer canonical LMCache advisory was fetched twice to compare both Reviewed identifiers; duplicate withdrawal is not a conflicting withdrawal of the canonical advisory.

database.summary: gomarkdown/markdown IsSafeURL panics on short URLs

observations: Maintainer affected field is literally <=0.0.0-20991231235959-ffffffffffff and patched_versions is null; Reviewed fixes at 0.0.0-20260724235538-61af6e1e6971. The future-looking sentinel is not treated as a verified release upper bound. Display keeps separately attributed Reviewed fix.
High/CVSS 3.1 7.5 vector agrees. Safelink rendering or direct IsSafeURL calls are relevant; default rendering without Safelink does not reach this path.

database.summary: LMCache: Remote code execution via unsafe deserialization in multiprocess mode transport

maintainer.summary: Remote code execution via unsafe deserialization in multiprocess mode transport

observations: Maintainer >=0.3.9,<0.5.6 and fixed 0.5.6 agree with Reviewed; Critical/CVSS 3.1 9.8 vector agrees.

Earlier description says no fix published; later Patches section and current structured fields explicitly state 0.5.6. Preserve this internal stale-prose difference; release candidates are described as affected.

Score concerns routable multiprocess transport. Default localhost and in-process mode differ. Wire format changed and all workers and servers must upgrade together; no real-world exploitation inference.
